Record Class Some<T>

Type Parameters:

public record Some<T>(T value) extends Record implements Option<T>
An option type that contains a value.

    • map

      public <R> Option<R> map(Function<? super T, ? extends R> mapper)
      Description copied from interface: Option
      Applies a mapping function to the value in this option, returning a new option containing the result of the mapping function. The function may return null; if so, an empty option is returned. Applying a mapping function to an empty option always returns another empty option. This function is equivalent to the following switch statement: 
      Option<?> option = ...;
Option<?> mapped = switch (option) {
  case Some(var value) -> Option.of(mappingFunction.apply(value));
  case None() -> Option.none();
};
      Specified by:
      map in interface Option<T>
      Type Parameters:
      R - The result type of the mapping function
      Parameters:
      mapper - The mapping function to apply.
      Returns:
      An option containing the result of the mapping operation, or an empty option if the mapping function returned null

      Description copied from interface: Option

      Specified by:

    • stream

      public Stream<T> stream()
      Description copied from interface: Option
      If a value is present, returns a sequential Stream containing only that value, otherwise returns an empty Stream.

      This method can be used to transform a Stream of option elements to a Stream of present value elements: 

      Stream<Option<T>> os = ..
Stream<T> s = os.flatMap(Option::stream)
      Specified by:
      stream in interface Option<T>
      Returns:
      the optional value as a Stream

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:

      Returns:
